description.en: You can easily assemble your favorite character!

description.en: Adopts a 3mm diameter shaft common to the 30 MINUTES series. Parts from ``30 MINUTES MISSIONS'' can also be installed as options.

description.en: Newly sculpted helmet + hair parts, chest emblem, and boots.

description.en: A 3mm diameter shaft is housed in the sole of the boot, allowing for increased expandability.

description.ja: ●　感情表現を豊かにする３種類の新規タンポ印刷の表情パーツが付属！
description.en: ● Comes with 3 types of new tampo-printed facial parts that enrich your emotional expression!

description.ja: 各種表情パーツ[カラーA]には、タンポ印刷を採用。

description.ja: ●　自分専用にカスタマイズ可能！豊富なカスタマイズ用パーツが付属。
description.en: ● Customizable for your own use! Comes with a wide variety of customization parts.

description.ja: アルト（陸戦仕様）のパーツや、30 MINUTESシリーズ対応ジョイント等が付属し、
description.en: Includes parts for Alto (land battle specification) and joints compatible with the 30 MINUTES series.

description.ja: 様々なカスタマイズ用パーツを使用することで自分好みのキャラクターメイクが可能。
description.en: You can create your own character by using various customization parts.

description.ja: 戦闘シーンから可憐な仕草まで様々なポージングが可能。
description.en: Various poses are possible, from battle scenes to cute gestures.

description.ja: 3種のミディアムヘアが付属。
description.en: Three types of medium hair are included.
